verdict.rationale: Evidence pack covers AutoGen's agent framework, teams, and AutoGen Studio UI for building/testing teams, but there is no mention of an observability UI, tracing dashboard, or logging system for capturing LLM calls and tool invocations per run. Missing for 10: any tracing/observability UI documentation, integration with tracing tools (e.g., OpenTelemetry), or evidence of call-level logging visualization.
